provisional_verified_claims.claim: Pure-state polygon necessity at arbitrary trace s>0
provisional_verified_claims.reconstruction: For normalized real T use a Schmidt pair u,v and commuting local rank-one projections P_j. Their sum N dominates I-ww^t for the joint larger-eigenvector product w. Bessel gives p+q<=1. Thus sum other lambda >=a(1-p)+(1-a)(1-q)>=a(2-p-q)>=a. Scaling by s gives polygon necessity for a_s(d). Zero smaller eigenvalue is immediate.

provisional_verified_claims.claim: Trace-one necessity for every feasible unit-ball determinant tuple
provisional_verified_claims.reconstruction: For d>0, implicit equation a_s(s-a_s)=d gives d_s log a_s=-1/sqrt(s^2-4d). A failed trace-one polygon has uniquely dominant d_i>0. Therefore every a_s(d_j)/a_s(d_i), j!=i, is increasing in s, and its sum stays below one for s<=1. Zero terms are exactly zero; the lower trace endpoint follows by continuity; if d_i=1/4 then only s=1 is allowed. This contradicts trace-s necessity.

provisional_verified_claims.claim: Exact real parity-support realization and G3 characterization
provisional_verified_claims.reconstruction: Weights on 000,011,101,110 are nonnegative by the t-triangle conditions and w0>=1/4. They sum to one. Bit-flip pairs never both lie in even parity, hence all marginal off-diagonals vanish; row-one squared norms are t1=w2+w3,t2=w1+w3,t3=w1+w2. Since each ti<=1/2, determinants are ti(1-ti). Necessity and construction prove equality on the closed cube, including zero weights and ti=1/2.

provisional_verified_claims.claim: Rank-one factor peeling preserves other Grams and norm
provisional_verified_claims.reconstruction: det(MM^t)=0 implies rank M<=1 by ker(MM^t)=ker M^t. Nonzero rank-one flattening factors T=u tensor S. Normalize u, giving ||S||=||T||. Contraction in every remaining mode multiplies its Gram by ||u||^2=1, so repeated peeling gives the exact closed zero-determinant slice.
